payload.text: hv, 26 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session, read by vc's date -u of 10:00Z. hv's words, on the zeopit desk, after hv closed the built-in's two empty desktops by hand: "That config isn't right. I have set things up now as I want them at zeopit now. The only difference is that at homere, the top-right screen isn't there and I want the Chrome+Safari windows to go onto a new space on the right-hand monito, at slot 2." The rest is vc's wording. vc edited hv's two desk files in ~/.config/arngz/desks on that word, with the files as they were kept in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-vc/desks-before-20261126-hv-edit. zeopit: main loses its 7th desktop (Music's) and its empty 9th, so it names 7 desktops there, and Music has no entry. homere: main's desktops are now the same as zeopit's; its monitor's three desktops are unchanged, and Chrome and Safari were already on its 2nd. `arngz list` and `arngz show` take both files. Neither is proved against the screens yet: zeopit by the next dry run, homere by hv at that place.
